Simple aggregations can give useful summary of our dataset, but often we would prefer to aggregate conditionally on some coordinate labels or groups. Xarray provides the so-called
workflow on xarray DataArrays and Datasets. The split-apply-combine operation is illustrated in this figure
The split step involves breaking up and grouping an xarray Dataset or DataArray depending on the value of the specified group key.
The apply step involves computing some function, usually an aggregate, transformation, or filtering, within the individual groups.
The combine step merges the results of these operations into an output xarray Dataset or DataArray.
